evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: For weekly blog observation opportunities, independently verify the declared page checks and workflow snippets, preserving failures as useful monitoring evidence.
intent.acceptance: Protected contemporaneous browser facts reproduce each native assertion; independent pinned compiler receipts establish snippet validation. Agent claims and run conclusions are never evidence.

evaluation.reason: Blog reachability and snippet usability predate this workflow; no historical independent browser/compiler captures exist in the supplied inventory. Acquisition remains pending, not exhausted.

summary.nativeLabel: Independently verified page checks per week

metrics.name: Independently assessed page checks
metrics.formula: Count known HTTP/domain/length/keyword assertions, at most four per weekly opportunity, including independently verified failures.

metrics.name: Passing page checks
metrics.formula: Count true independently assessed page assertions; no assertion about factual freshness.

metrics.name: Independently compiled workflow snippets
metrics.formula: Count eligible DOM code blocks with protected native compile receipts, regardless of exit status.

metrics.name: Schema-valid workflow snippets
metrics.formula: Count independently compiled eligible blocks with zero compiler exit code.

metrics.name: Fully passing explicit-check checkpoints
metrics.formula: Count captured checkpoints satisfying all page predicates, complete snippet compilation and independently verified latest compiler reference.

metrics.name: Workflow-linked independent page checks
metrics.formula: Count independently established page assertions with receipt-verified or explicitly corroborated workflow linkage; shared credit, not sole causation.

limitations: No independent historical native captures are currently retained; missingness is not zero delivery.
Discussion safe output expires after one day and closes older discussions; the shared issues/PR inventory does not cover Discussions.
Source experiment AIC, duration, discussion_created, validation_pass_rate and grader recurrence are costs/mechanism diagnostics, not accepted native value.
Page coverage is useful monitoring, not a generic quality score, factual correctness, uptime duration or proof of remediation.

Adoption source, reporting import and compiled workflow are retained. They used a different URL, compiler keyword, noon schedule and no snippet gate. Current-source compatibility is not backdated into those periods.
Partial subtotals cannot establish complete period movement; costs and keep/retire decision remain not measured/not rated.
